facts.text: Dual Decagonal Bio-Solar Arrays was deployed at Vastitas Borealis during Phoenix in 2008.
Twin fan-folding decagonal solar panels spanning 5.52 metres that unfolded like oriental fans after landing. In peak summer they produced 3.5 kWh daily under 24-hour midnight sun.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
Demonstrated the power profile of circular fan-fold arrays, paving the way for the UltraFlex arrays deployed on the InSight and Lucy spacecraft.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Vastitas Borealis.
Collapsed under hundreds of kilograms of dry-ice (CO2) frost during the brutal 2008–2009 polar winter, seen in HiRISE orbital images.
